summary: The complete legal domain contains only one through six decimal digits, which is too narrow for a reliable scaling trend; direct digit processing establishes the required bound.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source constraint 0 <= n <= 10^5 limits every legal input to at most six decimal digits.

replacement_checks.evidence: The zero case returns immediately; otherwise each loop iteration removes one decimal digit by division by ten, so every legal call performs at most six iterations.
The certificate regression compares both packaged sources with an independent string oracle for all 1,000,010 legal (n, x) combinations, including zero and the six-digit maximum.
